94 likes, 8 comments - financewithsonal_ on October 26, 2026: "🔐 SBI Account Holders: Important Banking Safety Tips

Reports about a possible data leak are a reminder to stay informed and take precautions while using digital banking.

Always keep your banking details private. Never share your OTP, ATM PIN, or net banking password with anyone. Be cautious of unexpected KYC messages and unfamiliar links, and verify banking-related communication through SBI’s official channels.

Regularly check your account activity and contact your bank if you notice any unauthorised transaction.

Save this post and share these digital banking safety tips with your family and friends.
